annotations.comment: The man on television was a condemned inmate, not L. Light exposed his killing power while the real investigator kept his own name and face hidden.
The broadcast claimed to be worldwide, but only aired in Kanto. Light's reaction shrinks a global search to one region. L has a location, but still needs an identity.
